title: Building n-Dimensional Trees for Resolution-Based Progressive Compression
problem: Strict error bounds in floating-point compression yield large files; users may not need full fidelity data
motivation: Progressive data access enables users to download initial fidelity then request higher fidelities on-demand
method: Resolution-based progressive compression using n-dimensional tree structures; studies fidelity progression tradeoffs
key_novelty: Hierarchical tree-based progressive compression enabling quality-resolution tradeoffs
contributions: Develops n-dimensional tree structures for progressive compression
Demonstrates competitive compression ratios vs. traditional methods
Analyzes quality impact of resolution progression
limitations: Limited evaluation details; unclear performance on various data types
